answer: Operator Liability Thread. Each identity carries an append-only thread of attestations signed by its operator's long-lived key. When any identity is proven sybil, enforcement quarantines every identity sharing that key on a shared mesa of flagged operators, and the operator's bonded reputation across all deployments is slashed and rate-limited, not the individual wallets. Registering a fresh key requires a slow jetty clearance period plus a stake-weighted delay proportional to the operator's prior flag count, so each new identity costs weeks of queue time and rising collateral.
